avis.titre: Holy Grail for Mature, Dry, Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I've got mature, dry, extremely sensitive skin. As a menopausal working woman, this product is one of the MOST EFFECTIVE, all-inclusive, products I NEVER skip. I've been using this product for over a year consistently now, and can tell you it is WORTH EVERY PENNY. It's reduced my fine lines, reduced and restored firmness, plays well with my eye cream/makeup for flawless skin-like look that lasts all day. I don't always have time for 1k step skin prep before I have to put on makeup and run out the door, but I need something that works well to tighten up without drying me out. This is a step I never miss. My eyes don't look dry, & makeup lasts longer. I've purchased this product 4 TIMES for not just myself but for my sister and best friend during the sales. It's pricey but the results and the difference before and after that lasts is undeniable. If you're not willing to do expensive surgery procedures, have dry skin, want preventative or treat existing fine lines, want moisture retention, firmer eyes in a 1& done this is THE PRODUCT. I waited a long time before I reviewed this product to be sure if it was something I wanted to recommend at this price point, but I've tried all sorts of eye creams, serums, and more over the years as I buy things on sale, but this one has always done the best job with less steps. If you get yourself one thing to pamper your skin under your eyes, gurl this is IT. Love this product DOWN. I'll be a customer for life. My only gripe is the packaging. W
